title: 第2801章 杀长老离开山谷第2800章 大战起凛冬天魂火
content_zh:
凛冬天魂火的威力巨大，若是全力催动起来，那恐怕会比寂灭之火还要恐怖。
动用这种异种火灭杀一个渡劫境后期的修士，那就是杀鸡用牛刀。
所以江若尘极为克制，在与这大长老交手的过程中，他仅仅只是动用了一点凛冬天魂火，将其融入了自己的剑法之中。
可即便只是那么一星半点，这对大长老都是形成碾压的。
只见江若尘的剑锋在碰触到大长老轰杀出来的灵气瞬间，那就跟火苗碰上了油一般，轰的一声巨响直接就骤然炸开。
并且顺着灵力喷涌而出的路径一路蔓延，很快就烧到了大长老的身上。
恐怖的火势在燃烧起来的瞬间，他大惊失色。
“啊？这是什么东西？”大长老惊恐，因为在火势燃烧起来的第一时间他就感受到了极大的威胁感。
这种威胁感是修士本能意识所产生的，完全不受他的控制。
然而这还不是最要命的。
最要命的是，在这大长老发出惊恐的声音之后，他立马就伸手使出手段想要将蔓延到他身上的火焰拍灭。
可是当他灵力催动拍打上去之后，不仅没能将火焰熄灭不说，火势反倒越来越旺了。
轰。
汹涌的火焰窜动，一下就将他的全身都包裹了起来，巨大的痛苦也开始从皮肤传来。
紧接着就是血肉，最后甚至是骨骼。
“啊，这到底是什么东西，你到底是什么人？”
巨大的痛苦让大长老发出惨叫，直接就在高空翻滚了起来，再无半点先前那高高在上的姿态。
哗。
这一幕的出现，瞬间就让周围的那些修士们看傻了眼。
特别是李家的那个客卿长老，他的境界高，所以比谁都清楚这钦天剑宗大长老的厉害的。

他原本瞧见江若尘跟这大长老厮杀起来，还以为两人会有好一番的缠斗呢。
但万万没有想到啊。
局势变化的这么快。
前一秒还高高在上的大长老，下一秒就成了丧家之犬在地上翻滚，哀嚎，这着实是令人意想不到。
不过最令他咂舌的还属江若尘。
他不知道江若尘是什么身份，但他可以清楚地感觉到，江若尘刚才所使出的手段，那是无比惊人的。
能让一个渡劫境后期的长老瞬间在地上翻滚，没有半点反抗之力，这绝对不是一般人能做到的。
客卿长老越想心中越是害怕，不自觉间额头就开始渗出点点汗水。
“长老！”
“大长老！”
……
而这时候，钦天剑宗的许多人也反应过来了。
看到自家的大长老突然被火焰吞噬，在空中翻滚，他们大惊之余也极为骇然起来。
甚至在情急之下还有好几个长老凑上前想帮忙。
可是凛冬天魂火是以灵气为食的，他们上去帮忙不仅不能起到作用不说，反倒还是在帮倒忙。
恐怖的火焰越发凶悍，甚至还在极短的时间内将他们好几个其他的长老也裹挟了进去。
顷刻间，天穹之上巨大的痛苦声此起彼伏。
“老狗，还嚣张吗？胆敢欺负小爷的师侄，你们所有人今天都休想活着离开这山谷。”
瞧着钦天剑宗大长老如此惨状，屠穹相当的得意。
这群人因为觊觎周阳看源石的本事，出动了如此多的人前来围杀，是一群穷凶极恶之徒。

屠穹对此那是深恶痛绝的。
更别说这些人追杀的对象还是周阳了。
content_en:
The power of the Winter Soul Fire is huge. If it is activated with all its strength, it will probably be even more terrifying than the Fire of Nirvana.
Using this kind of alien fire to kill a monk who is in the late stage of Tribulation Realm is just killing a chicken with a sledgehammer.
Therefore, Jiang Ruochen exercised great restraint. During the fight with the great elder, he only used a little bit of winter soul fire and integrated it into his own swordsmanship.
But even if it's just a little bit, these two great elders are crushing.
The moment Jiang Ruochen's sword touched the aura blasted out by the great elder, it exploded with a loud bang, just like flames hitting oil.
And it spread along the path of the spiritual power, and soon burned the great elder.
The moment the terrifying fire started burning, he was shocked.
"Ah? What is this?" The great elder was horrified, because he felt a great sense of threat as soon as the fire started burning.
This sense of threat is generated by the monk's instinctive consciousness and is completely beyond his control.
However, this is not the most terrible thing.
The most terrible thing is that after the great elder made a frightened sound, he immediately reached out and used any means to extinguish the flames that spread to him.
But when he slapped it with his spiritual power, not only was he unable to extinguish the flame, but it actually became more and more intense.
boom.
The raging flames surged and immediately enveloped his whole body, and huge pain began to radiate from his skin.
Next comes flesh, and finally even bones.
"Ah, what is this, and who are you?"
The huge pain caused the great elder to scream, and he rolled directly in the sky, without any of his previous aloof posture.
Wow.
The appearance of this scene immediately made the surrounding monks dumbfounded.
Especially the Keqing elder of the Li family, he is of a high level, so he knows better than anyone else how powerful the great elder of the Qintian Sword Sect is.
He originally saw Jiang Ruochen fighting with the elder, and thought they would have a good fight.
But I never expected it.
The situation changes so quickly.
The great elder who was so aloof one second turned into a bereaved dog rolling on the ground and wailing in the next second. This was really unexpected.
But the one who made him speechless the most was Jiang Ruochen.
He didn't know Jiang Ruochen's identity, but he could clearly feel that the methods Jiang Ruochen had just used were extremely shocking.
To be able to make an elder in the late stage of the Tribulation Realm instantly roll over on the ground without the slightest resistance, this is definitely not something that ordinary people can do.
The more Elder Keqing thought about it, the more frightened he became, and sweat began to drip from his forehead unconsciously.
"Elder!"
"Great Elder!"
…
At this time, many people in the Qintian Sword Sect also reacted.
Seeing their elder being suddenly swallowed up by flames and rolling in the air, they were shocked and horrified.
Even in desperation, several elders stepped forward to help.
However, the cold winter soul fire feeds on spiritual energy, so if they go to help, not only will they not be effective, they will actually be doing a disservice.
The terrifying flames became more and more fierce, even engulfing several other elders in a very short period of time.
In an instant, huge sounds of pain echoed across the sky.
"Old dog, are you still arrogant? If you dare to bully my nephew, all of you will never leave this valley alive today."
Seeing the miserable state of the great elder of the Qintian Sword Sect, Tu Qiong was quite proud.
This group of people coveted Zhou Yang's ability to see the Origin Stone, so they sent out so many people to surround and kill him. They were a group of extremely vicious people.
Tu Qiong hated this deeply.
Not to mention that the target these people are chasing is Zhou Yang.
